resources.string: Notification access: off. Used only to cross-check payments; notifications never create records.

Notification access greyed out? On Android 13+ Android blocks it for sideloaded apps until you allow it: Settings → Apps → UPI Detector → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings. Then come back here.
Shizuku is not running. Install Shizuku and start it (wireless debugging or adb), then come back.
Shizuku is too old (needs v11 or later). Update Shizuku.
Shizuku is running, but UPI Detector has not been allowed to use it.
Shizuku is ready. Start capture, then use GPay, PhonePe or Paytm as usual.
Reading GPay, PhonePe and Paytm screens while they are in front. Keeps running until you stop it.
UPI Detector is reading UPI app screens
Reads screens via Shizuku, only while GPay, PhonePe or Paytm is in front.
Removes this record as a duplicate of the earlier one. It cannot be undone.
Pending, failed, credit and flagged payments are not counted in the total.
Transactions, notes and the daily limit are saved on this phone. The live log and raw captures are memory only.
No raw screens captured yet. Open GPay, PhonePe or Paytm with capture running and raw capture enabled. The last 30 screens are kept in memory only.
No payments detected yet.\nStart capture, then make a small UPI payment (₹1) in GPay, PhonePe or Paytm.
Nothing logged yet. Open GPay, PhonePe or Paytm with capture running. The log is kept in memory only.
Deletes every saved transaction and note, and clears the log and raw captures. Your daily limit is kept.
Expense total: ₹%1$s (success, debit, not flagged) Success %2$d · Failed %3$d · Pending %4$d · Flagged %5$d
Today: ₹%1$s spent · no daily limit set
One limit for GPay, PhonePe and Paytm combined. You are warned on the Pay screen when a payment would take today\'s spend over it.
Enter an amount in rupees above 0, with at most 2 decimals.
You have spent ₹%1$s today. Paying ₹%2$s brings it to ₹%3$s, over your daily limit of ₹%4$s.
This is a warning only: it cannot stop the payment.
